dz: 新斯科舍省立法会的首次省级选举,是继加拿大联邦为成为总理的威廉·安南德所领导的反共党恢复了绝大多数席位后举行的.
de: The first provincial election for the Nova Scotia Legislative Assembly after Canada's Confederation returns a large majority for the Anti-Confederation Party, led by William Annand, who becomes Premier.

t: 约翰·贝尔·胡德(John Bell Hood)开始富兰克林-纳什维尔运动,试图将威廉·特克姆…
te: John Bell Hood begins the Franklin–Nashville Campaign in an unsuccessful attempt to draw William Tecumseh Sherman back …
dz: 美国内战:约翰·贝尔·胡德(John Bell Hood)开始富兰克林-纳什维尔运动,试图将威廉·特克姆塞赫·谢尔曼引出佐治亚州,但没有成功.
de: American Civil War: John Bell Hood begins the Franklin–Nashville Campaign in an unsuccessful attempt to draw William Tecumseh Sherman back out of Georgia.

t: 奇克马乌加战役从邦联和邦联部队开始. 除了葛底斯堡之外,它还涉及到任何一场美国内战战役的第二高…
te: The Battle of Chickamauga begins between Confederate and Union forces. It involves the second highest amount of casualt…
dz: 美国内战:奇克马乌加战役从邦联和邦联部队开始. 除了葛底斯堡之外,它还涉及到任何一场美国内战战役的第二高伤亡.
de: American Civil War: The Battle of Chickamauga begins between Confederate and Union forces. It involves the second highest amount of casualties for any American Civil War battle apart from Gettysburg.

t: 南部邦联第一次也是唯一一次庆祝感恩节。
te: The Confederate States celebrate for the first and only time a Thanksgiving Day.
dz: 南部邦联第一次也是唯一一次庆祝感恩节。
de: The Confederate States celebrate for the first and only time a Thanksgiving Day.

t: 卡斯特尔菲达尔多之战:皇家撒丁岛军队击败了教皇国的军队,结果被意大利王国征服了乌姆布里亚和马奇.
te: Battle of Castelfidardo: Royal Sardinian Army defeats forces of the Papal States, resulting in the conquest of Umbria a…
dz: 意大利统一之战:卡斯特尔菲达尔多之战:皇家撒丁岛军队击败了教皇国的军队,结果被意大利王国征服了乌姆布里亚和马奇.
de: Wars of Italian Unification: Battle of Castelfidardo: Royal Sardinian Army defeats forces of the Papal States, resulting in the conquest of Umbria and Marche by the Kingdom of Italy.

t: 张家湾之战：英法联军刚刚占领天津后，正在向北京进发，在张家湾与一支规模更大的清朝军队交战并击败…
te: Battle of Zhangjiawan: Now heading towards Beijing after having recently occupied Tianjin, the allied Anglo-French forc…
dz: 第二次鸦片战争：张家湾之战：英法联军刚刚占领天津后，正在向北京进发，在张家湾与一支规模更大的清朝军队交战并击败了他们。
de: Second Opium War: Battle of Zhangjiawan: Now heading towards Beijing after having recently occupied Tianjin, the allied Anglo-French force engages and defeats a larger Qing Chinese army at Zhangjiawan.

t: 美国国会通过了1850年"逃亡奴隶法".
te: The U.S. Congress passes the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850.
dz: 美国国会通过了1850年"逃亡奴隶法".
de: The U.S. Congress passes the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850.

t: 反冕法会由理查德·科布登所建立.
te: The Anti-Corn Law League is established by Richard Cobden.
dz: 反冕法会由理查德·科布登所建立.
de: The Anti-Corn Law League is established by Richard Cobden.

t: Tiffany & Co. (最初被命名为Tiffany & Young)由查尔斯·刘易斯·蒂…
te: Tiffany & Co. (first named Tiffany & Young) is founded by Charles Lewis Tiffany and Teddy Young in New York City. The s…
dz: Tiffany & Co. (最初被命名为Tiffany & Young)由查尔斯·刘易斯·蒂凡尼和泰迪·杨在纽约市创办. 该店被称作"花花公子和花花公子".
de: Tiffany & Co. (first named Tiffany & Young) is founded by Charles Lewis Tiffany and Teddy Young in New York City. The store is called a "stationery and fancy goods emporium".

t: 智利第一政府军。 虽然它本应只在西班牙半岛战争期间统治,但事实上它是从西班牙独立的第一步,并因…
te: First Government Junta in Chile. Though supposed to rule only during the Peninsular War in Spain, it is in fact the fir…
dz: 智利第一政府军。 虽然它本应只在西班牙半岛战争期间统治,但事实上它是从西班牙独立的第一步,并因此被纪念.
de: First Government Junta in Chile. Though supposed to rule only during the Peninsular War in Spain, it is in fact the first step towards independence from Spain, and is commemorated as such.

t: 伦敦克文特花园的皇家歌剧院开幕.
te: The Royal Opera House in Covent Garden, London, opens.
dz: 伦敦克文特花园的皇家歌剧院开幕.
de: The Royal Opera House in Covent Garden, London, opens.

t: 法国与印度战争：魁北克投降条款签署。
te: The Articles of Capitulation of Quebec are signed.
dz: 法国与印度战争：魁北克投降条款签署。
de: French and Indian War: The Articles of Capitulation of Quebec are signed.

t: 贝尔格莱德条约签订后,奥地利将萨瓦河和多瑙河以南的土地割让给奥斯曼帝国.
te: The Treaty of Belgrade is signed, whereby Austria cedes lands south of the Sava and Danube rivers to the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 贝尔格莱德条约签订后,奥地利将萨瓦河和多瑙河以南的土地割让给奥斯曼帝国.
de: The Treaty of Belgrade is signed, whereby Austria cedes lands south of the Sava and Danube rivers to the Ottoman Empire.

t: 中美长计历中第十二个baktun开始.
te: The twelfth baktun in the Mesoamerican Long Count calendar begins.
dz: 中美长计历中第十二个baktun开始.
de: The twelfth baktun in the Mesoamerican Long Count calendar begins.

t: 胡安·鲍蒂斯塔·帕斯泰内(Juan Bautista Pastene)的远征使智利南部的圣佩德…
te: The expedition of Juan Bautista Pastene makes landfall in San Pedro Bay, southern Chile, claiming the territory for Spa…
dz: 胡安·鲍蒂斯塔·帕斯泰内(Juan Bautista Pastene)的远征使智利南部的圣佩德罗湾登陆,为西班牙宣称领土.
de: The expedition of Juan Bautista Pastene makes landfall in San Pedro Bay, southern Chile, claiming the territory for Spain.

t: 在乔伊尼采战役中,波兰军队被特奥特克骑士所击败.
te: In the Battle of Chojnice, the Polish army is defeated by the Teutonic knights.
dz: 13年战争:在乔伊尼采战役中,波兰军队被特奥特克骑士所击败.
de: Thirteen Years' War: In the Battle of Chojnice, the Polish army is defeated by the Teutonic knights.

t: 菲利普·奥古斯都于15岁成为法国国王.
te: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at the age of fifteen.
dz: 菲利普·奥古斯都于15岁成为法国国王.
de: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at the age of fifteen.

t: 挪威国王哈拉尔德·哈德拉达与托斯蒂克·戈德温森一起在罕伯河口登陆并开始入侵英格兰.
te: Norwegian king Harald Hardrada lands with Tostig Godwinson at the mouth of the Humber River and begins his invasion of …
dz: 挪威国王哈拉尔德·哈德拉达与托斯蒂克·戈德温森一起在罕伯河口登陆并开始入侵英格兰.
de: Norwegian king Harald Hardrada lands with Tostig Godwinson at the mouth of the Humber River and begins his invasion of England.

t: 拜占庭-格鲁吉亚联合军队和塞尔柱军队之间的卡佩特龙战役.
te: Battle of Kapetron between a combined Byzantine-Georgian army and a Seljuq army.
dz: 拜占庭-格鲁吉亚联合军队和塞尔柱军队之间的卡佩特龙战役.
de: Battle of Kapetron between a combined Byzantine-Georgian army and a Seljuq army.

t: 君士坦丁大帝在克赖索波利斯之战中果断地击败了利西尼乌斯,建立了君士坦丁对罗马帝国的唯一控制.
te: Constantine the Great decisively defeats Licinius in the Battle of Chrysopolis, establishing Constantine's sole control…
dz: 君士坦丁大帝在克赖索波利斯之战中果断地击败了利西尼乌斯,建立了君士坦丁对罗马帝国的唯一控制.
de: Constantine the Great decisively defeats Licinius in the Battle of Chrysopolis, establishing Constantine's sole control over the Roman Empire.

t: 多米蒂安皇帝因妻子多米蒂亚和两个普拉多里安都督的阴谋被刺杀. 然后Nerva被宣布为他的继任者.
te: Emperor Domitian is assassinated as a result of a plot by his wife Domitia and two Praetorian prefects. Nerva is then p…
dz: 多米蒂安皇帝因妻子多米蒂亚和两个普拉多里安都督的阴谋被刺杀. 然后Nerva被宣布为他的继任者.
de: Emperor Domitian is assassinated as a result of a plot by his wife Domitia and two Praetorian prefects. Nerva is then proclaimed as his successor.
